summary: Comprehensive testing of Term Management and Student Statistics features completed successfully. All 13 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified the 'إغلاق الفصل وبدء فصل جديد' button in AdminDashboard and the statistics table in StudentDashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Term management APIs and student statistics are fully functional. The 'إغلاق الفصل وبدء فصل جديد' button in AdminDashboard opens a dialog with warning message and input for new term name. Student statistics table correctly displays: نقاط الفصل (term points), عدد التسميعات (recitations_count), عدد ورق المتابعة (sheets_count), الحضور (present), الغياب (absent), نسبة الحضور (percentage).

admin_dashboard.term_close_button: PASSED - Button 'إغلاق الفصل وبدء فصل جديد' visible and clickable
admin_dashboard.term_dialog: PASSED - Dialog opens with warning message, current term display, and new term name input
admin_dashboard.active_term_display: PASSED - Shows current active term name

student_dashboard.statistics_table: PASSED - Table 'إحصائياتي في الفصل الحالي' displays correctly
student_dashboard.sheets_count: PASSED - Shows عدد ورق المتابعة (using sheets_count)

backend_apis.GET /api/terms/active: PASSED - Returns active term with name and is_active fields
backend_apis.POST /api/terms/close-and-start-new: PASSED - Closes current term and creates new one (admin only)
backend_apis.GET /api/statistics/student/{id}: PASSED - Returns complete student statistics with correct structure

/api/statistics/student/{id}.tracking.sheets_count: Verified - Returns integer count of tracking sheets
/api/statistics/student/{id}.recitation.recitations_count: Verified - Returns integer count of recitations
/api/statistics/student/{id}.attendance.present: Verified - Returns integer count of present days
/api/statistics/student/{id}.attendance.absent: Verified - Returns integer count of absent days
